_comment: Recorded Grok answers for the order history (demo data), so the seed runs with the network off. They go through exactly the same code checks as a live answer. Values like {{invoice}} or {{amount}} are filled in by agent/lib/demo/history.ts from the Mini ERP documents of that order (invoice numbers are given out when the seed runs); a value that is only a placeholder becomes a number.

BEN-31877.mail:
Oggetto: Differenza di prezzo sull'ordine BEN-31877 — CTR-SCOTTI-BEN-2026

Gentile Bennet (demo),

abbiamo ricevuto il vostro messaggio ORDERS per l'ordine BEN-31877. Il prezzo unitario indicato non corrisponde al contratto di fornitura CTR-SCOTTI-BEN-2026 tra Bennet (demo) e Riso Scotti S.p.A. (demo).

Dettaglio:
- GTIN 8003660012460: ordinato a €2.79, prezzo di contratto €2.69 (quantità 3600.0)

Vi chiediamo di confermare il prezzo di contratto o di inviarci un ORDERS corretto.

Cordiali saluti,
Riso Scotti S.p.A. (demo)
(Bozza: da rivedere e inviare a mano)

Invoice {{invoice}} bills {{shipped}} packs at {{price}}, the quantity on the DESADV

Invoice {{invoice}} bills the {{shipped}} packs shipped at {{price}}

read_claim.raw_notes: Shortage found at a month-end inventory, eleven days after delivery; cites internal receiving report RCV-IPR-10233

But Iper cites a receiving report (RCV-IPR-10233) that is not in the Mini ERP, and the count was made eleven days later. A person should ask Iper for the report before replying.

points.text: Signed DDT with no reservation: everything received on {{deliver_date}}
Order, DESADV and invoice agree on {{shipped}} packs
Contract {{contract}}: shortages must be written on the DDT; a later claim needs the CeDi's receiving report, which we do not have
